dedupe_keys.name: pypsa pl poland energy system model

description: PyPSA-PL is a ready-to-use optimisation model of Poland's energy system built on the PyPSA framework. It includes a national dataset and, since version 3.1, 16 voivodeship nodes with transmission and distribution expansion costs. Users can optimise investments in electricity, heat, hydrogen and light-vehicle technologies or run hourly dispatch for a fixed asset mix. Inputs are demand, technology costs, plant attributes and scenario constraints; outputs are system capacities, flows, dispatch and costs. Its place is Poland, with hourly operation and planning years selected by the modeller. The GitHub source is free under MIT terms and documents Python installation. A limitation is that policy and cost conclusions depend on the bundled data version, spatial aggregation and scenario assumptions. The model can support power, heating and transport decarbonisation simulations. It is distinct from the catalogue's general model-pypsa record, which supplies the modelling framework, not Poland's configured case. This review did not download its dataset or solve a scenario.
